summary: The diff implements most requirements across backend and frontend. Backend methods (recordVisit, getVisitHistory, getProfileRowUsers, getLatestPostByUser, hasNewPostSince) appear to be added in main.mo. The migration.mo file is created with visitHistory initialization. StoriesRow is updated with polling and glow logic. UserProfilePage appears to have recordVisit calls. However, several acceptance criteria details cannot be fully verified due to truncation, and the ~30-second polling interval in StoriesRow is not explicitly confirmed in the visible diff.

missing_requirements.requirement: Polling interval of ~30 seconds to re-evaluate glow state without full page reload
missing_requirements.reason: The StoriesRow diff shows the component fetches profile row users and glow state via hooks (useGetProfileRowUsers, useProfilesWithNewPosts), but the visible diff does not show a polling interval (e.g., refetchInterval: 30000) configured. The hooks are in useQueries.ts which is truncated, so the polling configuration cannot be confirmed.
